title: a8-capture-screen-references report (also the pack's reference/screenshots/index.json)
description: What was captured, and — as importantly — what was not and why. See docs/phase-a-inventory.md, 'Visual reference'.

viewport.description: The viewport every capture was taken at. Recorded because a reference image without one invites a reader to infer a breakpoint the application never declared.

state.description: A short stable slug for what this capture shows: 'default', 'validation-failed', 'role-MANAGER', 'panel-expanded'. Stable across runs — it is part of the filename and of the manifest.

state_reason.description: Why this state was worth a second capture — normally the RULE/EL node whose guard changes what renders. null for 'default'.

acting_role.description: The AUTHN declared_role the capture was taken as, or null when the screen is not role-dependent.

not_captured.description: Every active SCR with no capture, and why. An empty array on an application with unreachable screens is the failure this step exists to prevent — 'the capture found nothing' and 'there was nothing to capture' must not read identically, which is the same confusion the AUTHN node exists to resolve for identity.

reason.description: unreachable_with_seed_data is a finding about the seed set and belongs in the Phase 0 record; requires_external_system is a finding about the environment.

detail.description: Free text: what was tried, what happened.
